concept.title: Automatic adjustment of rearview mirrors in reverse (Auto reverse)

conbody.p: When you shift the gear to the R (Reverse) position, the outside rearview mirror(s) will rotate downwards to aid with driving in reverse.
The position of the outside rearview mirror switch (1) determines whether the mirrors will move:
Left/Right: When either the L (Left) or R (Right) switch is selected, both outside rearview mirrors will move.
Neutral: When neither switch is selected, the outside rearview mirrors will not move.
The outside rearview mirrors will automatically revert to their original positions if any of the following occur:

li.p: The EV button is placed to either the OFF position or the POWER ON position.
The gear is shifted to any position except R (Reverse).
The remote control outside rearview mirror switch is not selected.
